jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A m4 on1 lok6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something makes a person or animal feel upset, uneasy, or uncomfortable.

examples.english: The sudden noise can unsettle me so much that I cannot sleep all night.
examples.traditional: 突然嘅巨響搞到我唔安樂，成晚都瞓唔着。
